### Not yet run — actionable

- 271 `ms` reading(s) without Akoma Ntoso
- 235 `en` reading(s) without Akoma Ntoso
- 1 `unsettled` reading(s) without Akoma Ntoso

### Scanned — needs the cross-check tier, not another run

24 stored document(s) are image-only scans with no text layer. The local reader (ADR-035) found nothing in them and correctly wrote nothing, so re-running `extract-markdown` will never produce a reading. These are the documents `structure-handoff` and the cross-check tier exist for.

### Needs a decision

127 reading(s) are dropped by `publish` because another reading of the same bill and language already claims their Expression IRI. ADR-024's scheme carries no chamber component, and a bill that passes through both chambers has one document per chamber per language.

**123 of them cost nothing**: the two chambers link the same file, so the dropped reading is byte-identical to the one that was kept.

**4 lose text that differs** — this is the real consequence of the limitation, and the served corpus is missing one version of each:

- `dr-28-2023 (en): doc-5242c71d, doc-e7739a1e`
- `dr-28-2023 (ms): doc-19825d20, doc-ccee2059`
- `dr-33-2025 (en): doc-3e39ae75, doc-6d73f773`
- `dr-33-2025 (ms): doc-3001abdb, doc-ea08a68e`

119 of these also collide among promoted Akoma Ntoso, which is what `verify` reports.
